transportAndCredentialPolicy.transportKindRationale: A Unix domain socket bound under a runtime-owned, freshly created, mode-0700 temporary directory has no host/port surface to spoof, cannot be reached by any remote network path, and cannot be confused with a loopback TCP port that has been forwarded from a real remote host. This authority selects Unix domain socket exclusively; loopback TCP is not an authorized alternative and must not be offered as an implementation choice.
transportAndCredentialPolicy.cleanupScopeRestriction: Cleanup may act only on the exact runtime-created and ownership-verified path(s) for this execution run; cleanup must never touch the Repository working tree, any pre-existing user PostgreSQL installation or data directory, or any container/process this execution run did not itself create.

must not be used alone as proof of live execution against a real PostgreSQL server

newRawExplainTextSha256.definition: The SHA-256 of the exact byte sequence Buffer.from(rawExplainText, "utf8") produces, where rawExplainText is the unparsed text value of the PostgreSQL EXPLAIN (... FORMAT JSON) result field, obtained via a custom pg text parser, before any JSON.parse of that text occurs.
newRawExplainTextSha256.encodingRequirement: both server_encoding and client_encoding must be UTF8 for this suite's connection; the execution CLI must verify and record this before any measurement begins
newRawExplainTextSha256.computationTiming: computed immediately upon receipt of rawExplainText, strictly before JSON.parse is applied to obtain explainJson
newRawExplainTextSha256.scopeExclusion: does not include PostgreSQL wire protocol framing; must not be described as a raw network packet hash
newRawExplainTextSha256.storageRequirement: the exact same byte sequence used to compute rawExplainTextSha256 must be written verbatim to a raw observation file inside the formal evidence bundle
newRawExplainTextSha256.writeVerificationRequirement: after writing, the execution provenance module must re-read the file from disk and recompute the SHA-256, and this recomputed value must equal rawExplainTextSha256 exactly, or the run fails closed

bindingChain.description: the execution manifest must record the complete chain: rawExplainTextSha256 -> the parsed explainJson value derived from it -> the existing explainSha256 computed from that same explainJson by the unchanged existing runner/validator -> the final evidence artifact's own SHA-256.

formalPassRequiresAllOf: every raw observation file SHA PASS
baseline/candidate cluster and dataset isolation PASS
the manifest's synthetic boolean equals false
the manifest's execution mode equals FORMAL_LIVE
formalValidatorMustReject: existing evidence with no accompanying manifest
a mock or fixture producer identity
artificial PASS evidence lacking full formal bundle provenance

assuranceBoundary.whatTheManifestAndHashChainCanVerify: internal integrity, source-flow consistency, and cross-artifact consistency across the manifest, the raw observation files, the existing evidence, and the implementation artifacts.
assuranceBoundary.whatItCannotVerify: It cannot provide unforgeable remote attestation against a malicious operator who has full local administrative control and can fabricate arbitrary processes, files, and PIDs on the machine performing the run.
assuranceBoundary.independentReviewStillRequired: Formal acceptance still requires an independent reviewer to confirm the actual execution command, the actual runtime identity, the complete output hashes, and the actual cleanup result — the manifest is evidence submitted for that review, not a replacement for it.
assuranceBoundary.localSelfSignedTimestampOrEphemeralKeyPr: Neither a local self-signed timestamp nor a locally generated ephemeral key may be claimed, alone, as proof of genuine PostgreSQL execution.

failureSemantics.candidateLifecycle: This candidate permits no execution implementation, no PostgreSQL 17.6 acquisition, no formal suite, no Freeze, and no retrospective PASS.

Execution implementation authorization does not exist before that review reaches a READY FOR FREEZE verdict and this candidate is then Frozen.
